title: jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile
why_read: A technically interesting compatibility layer bringing a Windows/console game engine to iOS and macOS, relevant to engineers interested in emulation and porting work.
analysis: This project claims to be a compatibility layer allowing a commercial game, Diablo II: Resurrected, to run natively on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, requiring users to supply their own legally owned game files. Building such a compatibility or translation layer for a modern game engine onto mobile hardware is a genuinely hard reverse-engineering and systems problem, similar in spirit to Wine or Proton-style projects. The legal status is murkier than typical emulation projects since it is reimplementing or wrapping a live commercial multiplayer game rather than an old abandoned title, which readers should keep in mind. Technically it's interesting for anyone curious about low-level porting, graphics API translation, and touch-control adaptation work.
